data.title: API
data.tagline: An agreed way for two pieces of software to request and return information
data.description: For example, a weather app can ask a weather service for today's Shenzhen forecast and receive the temperature and conditions. The API defines where the request goes, what it carries, and what comes back; it is not the page, backend code, or database.

flowLesson.title: Which parts handle one save?

steps.label: Edit and save
steps.detail: Read the input and show a pending state

steps.label: Send the request
steps.detail: Use the API contract's URL, method, and data

steps.label: Receive, check, and process
steps.detail: Receive the request and validate the input, identity, and permission

steps.label: Return the result
steps.detail: Return success, failure, and the reason under the API contract

steps.label: Show the result
steps.detail: Update the page from the real response

flowLesson.boundary: An HTTP 200 only means the request received a normal response. Business success still depends on the API contract and response data.

practice.title: Saving produces no result. How do you first check whether the API is involved?

options.label: In Network, inspect the URL, method, request data, status, response body, and whether the page updates from it
options.feedback: Correct. These show whether the request followed the contract, what the service returned, and whether the UI handled it correctly.

options.label: Rewrite the request parameters from the API docs, then retry immediately
options.feedback: The docs may differ from the live call; inspect the request and response that actually occurred first.

options.label: Restart the API service first, then retry the same page action
options.feedback: Restarting may restore a transient failure, but it does not locate a contract mismatch.

flowLesson.agentPrompt: Saving produces no result. Inspect the API URL, method, submitted data, status, response body, and how the page handles it. Fix the cause, save again, confirm the response matches the contract and the page shows the right result; if it persists data, refresh to confirm it remains.
